Made in Italy Murano tradition

This masterpiece of an Italian chandelier is adorned with 60 Clear Prism Glass pieces of the quadriedri type. With its 60 handcrafted Italian glass elements, this chandelier will undoubtedly become a stunning focal point in any room it graces. The frame comes standard in patinated chrome (as shown in the images), but is also available in shiny chrome, matte gold, patinated matte gold, shiny gold, and brass.

Read more about choosing a frame here.

Have a question or need guidance — send us a message or email and we will help you find the perfect chandelier for you.

*Made to order

Dimensions
Height incl. chain: 120 cm
Height: 56 cm
Diameter: 44 cm

Glass:
Height: 28 cm
Width: 3 cm

The chain length can be easily adjusted and shortened at home. It is also possible to order a longer chain if desired. We can also shorten the chain before we send the chandelier - just let us know.
Lights
6 × E14 (not included)
Compatible with dimmer
Weight
18 kg
Shipping & delivery time

Delivery time is typically 2–3 weeks, often closer to 2 weeks or less.

All our chandeliers are handcrafted to order and shipped directly from Italy. If you choose a gold frame that is not in stock, please allow approximately one extra week for production.

We ship with DHL / FedEx, offering flexible delivery options. Shipments are always insured.

All inclusive

Items are shipped from Italy within the EU. For EU customers, this means no additional customs duties or fees upon delivery — the price you see is the price you pay, delivered to your door.

Outside the EU, local import duties may apply. We recommend checking the regulations in your market before placing an order.
